controls: The drafting feature defaults to deterministic mode and remains on that baseline until the explicit model-enabled flag is set.
JSONProvider refuses local or hosted drafting unless the caller explicitly marks the source synthetic.
Hosted drafting also retains its synthetic-only disclosure, provider allowlist and billing-cap checks.
The application encounter input schema only admits synthetic_data=true; the API therefore cannot route a non-synthetic encounter into the optional model adapter.
The new regression rejects a local model call with synthetic=false; deterministic drafting remains unaffected.

limitations: This constraint is based on the application’s synthetic-only encounter contract; broadening the product to real clinical data requires a new authorization and privacy review before changing it.
This establishes a configuration and routing guard, not drafting quality or clinical readiness.
No paid provider calls were made.
